metadata.description: Claude Code skills marketplace — engineering, stack, security, legal and workflow skills, organized one plugin per domain

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Software engineering fundamentals (41 skills): GoF design patterns, algorithms & data structures, architectural styles (DDD, hexagonal, microservices, event-driven, monoliths, well-architected), backend/frontend architecture, craftsmanship (SOLID, clean code, refactoring, twelve-factor, clean architecture), and enterprise integration patterns.

plugins.name: stack
plugins.description: .NET library selection and usage (19 skills): MassTransit, MediatR, AutoMapper, Dapper, Serilog, Polly, Redis, Validot, NCrontab, Topshelf, OpenAPI, ASP.NET Identity, i18n, observability/OTLP, Plunk email, Docker, and project hygiene.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security practices and OWASP (16 skills): threat modeling, authentication, cryptography, data protection, input validation, API security, logging & monitoring, supply chain, penetration testing, red teaming, secure SDLC, security testing, and AI security.

plugins.name: legal
plugins.description: Compliance and regulation for SaaS (16 skills): privacy & data protection (GDPR/LGPD/CCPA), open-source licensing, billing & taxation, accessibility, consumer protection, content moderation, contracts, cybersecurity compliance, employment, export controls, financial/healthcare regulation, IP, and AI regulation.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: Cross-cutting developer tools (3 skills): Docker (Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, Compose, image optimization, registries) and Git (branching, merge vs rebase, conflict resolution, hooks, worktrees, bisect, conventional commits).

plugins.name: QA
plugins.description: Browser automation, E2E testing, and BDD: playwright-cli (navigation, form submission, network interception, screenshots, a11y/perf/SEO audits, console/network error capture) and bdd-gherkin (authoring domain-driven Gherkin/Cucumber .feature files and acceptance criteria).

plugins.name: workflows
plugins.description: Plan execution orchestrator: execute a single plan file end-to-end — branch setup, phased execution, commit/push/PR, and the completion signal.

plugins.name: specs
plugins.description: Specifications & architecture documentation (19 skills): diagramming (C4, Mermaid, UML, PlantUML, D2, ERD, TOGAF, ArchiMate, functional) and specification documents (PRD, TRD, BRD, ADR, RFC, Gherkin, Gauge).
